entry_state: Exchangeability depends on the entity, currency direction, date and purpose. findings: Exhibit indentation does not establish control or unrestricted transfer rights, and issuer permission does not establish issuance.

Surcharge determination, effective date, observation date, publication and reporting vintage remain separate. Proposed amendments and official rounding explanations do not establish a complete applicable rule history.
